text:
carla (AE): Hey infra — need temporary dedicated capacity for a Stripe POC demo Tues 3pm PT. Customer expects p95 <200ms for ~90 mins. Looking for 4x A100-equivalent in us-west-2 under pool demo-stripe-poc. Need burst window + relaxed autoscale to avoid cold starts. Can you provision and confirm costs and billing entity?

maria (SE): Quick Qs — which model variant and expected peak RPS? We usually recommend quantized 13B for this kind of demo. Also do you want prefix caching warmed?

carla (AE): Model is catalog:gpt-neox-13b-quant. Peak ~80 RPS, average ~30 RPS, demo + prep ~2.5 hours. Yes, we'll warm caching. Billing should go to Stripe POC (acct stripe-demo-2026).

ryan (Infra): I can take this. Proposed policy: min_replicas=2, max_replicas=10, burst_credits=12000, grace_period=600s. Schedule start 2026-03-24 14:45 UTC, stop 2026-03-24 17:30 UTC. We'll create a short-lived API key scoped to the demo. Need approval from AE for costs.

maria (SE): Here's an autoscale policy snippet we can apply (put into policy.json and run redwoodctl):
```
{
  "min_replicas": 2,
  "max_replicas": 10,
  "scale_up_cpu_threshold": 0.65,
  "burst_credits": 12000,
  "grace_period_seconds": 600
}
```
This keeps 2 warm workers and gives burst headroom for the 80 RPS spikes. We'll pin the model and enable prefix/KV caching on the pool.

david (SRE): Security checklist: create dedicated API key labelled 'stripe-poc-demo' with TTL 8h and scopes: generate, embeddings (if used). Hosted deployment — no VPC peering available for demos. If customer requires VPC/isolation we escalate to Private deployment (longer lead time). Enable request-logging to S3 for audit and set retention 30 days.

ops-bot: Provision job queued: #PROV-98231. Estimated completion: 18 minutes.

carla (AE): Thanks — can you give a quick cost estimate so I can get internal sign-off? Also confirm what gets billed as reserved vs burst.

maria (SE): Ballpark calc: demo reserved rate (demo discount) = $3.20/hr per GPU. For 4 GPUs = $12.80/hr. For 3 hours active = $38.40. Estimate burst credit token consumption & network/storage ~ $6. Contingency/overhead ~$10. Rough total ~ $55. Note: actual billing will show reserved capacity hours + any additional usage consumed beyond reserved.

ryan (Infra): Provisioned and scheduled. Pool id: demo-stripe-poc-1867. Autoscale policy applied. API key created: stripe-poc-demo (expires 2026-03-24T20:45Z). Notes: billing entity set to stripe-demo-2026. If we see p95 >200ms during the demo I'll manually scale-up and notify.

carla (AE): Awesome thanks :tada: I'll share the API key with the customer securely and send them a short prep doc.

maria (SE): I'll drop a runbook with warmup prompts and KV cache commands ~1 hour before start.

david (SRE): Request-logging enabled and retention set to 30 days. Audit path: s3://redwood-audit/stripe-poc-demo/2026-03-24.

carla (AE): Closing loop — handing off runbook ownership to maria and infra ops to ryan for the demo window. Will ping here if customer requests VPC or longer-term dedicated commit. Thanks everyone!
